title: Front-End Adding & Subtracting
summary: Add and subtract in your head by working from the left: the biggest place first (hundreds, then tens, then ones), then put the parts together. When the ones are too small to subtract, jump back in two steps.
bigIdeas: Start with the biggest part of each number: it gives you most of the answer straight away.
Split a number into hundreds, tens and ones, work with each part, then join them.
tips: Add from the left: $47 + 38$ is $70$ and $15$, so $85$.
Say the tens first, then the ones: you hear most of the answer straight away.
Bigger numbers work the same: $325 + 142$ is $400 + 60 + 7 = 467$.
Subtract in two jumps: $72 - 38$ is $72 - 30 = 42$, then $42 - 8 = 34$.
Check a subtraction by adding back: $34 + 38 = 72$.
